acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Burrowers family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Burrowing Worm, T2, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Eruption Soldier archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Long annelid body with armored front rings, flexible pale rear segments, broad shovel mandibles, and many short tactile whiskers.
Signature mechanic: Moving-Ridge Eruption: an accelerating ridge ends in a vertical bite while the long rear body remains stranded above ground.
battlefieldDuty: Cross a long underground lane, erupt beneath a target, and leave rear segments exposed while turning.
constructionDimensions: Chitin, hide, mandibles, sensory whiskers, soil, saliva, and scars remain ordinary and biologically segmented.
Subsurface travel reads through displaced soil, embedded-stone motion, crack geometry, and exposed rear segments.
counterplay: Avoid the endpoint and attack the exposed soft rear segments during the slow turn underground. Affinity signal: The leading ridge, jaw convergence, real stone displacement, exposed tail, or feeding collar remains visible before and after commitment.
forbiddenTreatments: Legs, wings, humanoid torsos, or draconic features
identityInvariants: Every form retains a limbless segmented body, armored digging front, softer articulated rear, tactile sensory organs, and soil-displacing locomotion.
Tier is shown through mandible specialization, segment reinforcement, collar structure, tail shape, and tunneling behavior rather than humanoid traits.
The real underground route and the exposed punish segment always have physical environmental tells.

sourceReferences: Retired legacy bridge reframed into canonical fauna

telegraph: A widening ridge accelerates and embedded pebbles jump at the eruption endpoint.
